depiction.primary_object: three horizontal list bars with curved downward arrow
modifiers: curved arrow looping from top bar to bottom bar
depiction.composition: side-by-side arrow on left and three stacked horizontal lines on right

readings.meaning: move to bottom of list / deprioritize

ambiguity: Easily confused with text-wrapping, indent/outdent, undo, or playlist repeat/loop controls at small sizes.

modifier_semantics.modifier: curved arrow from top to bottom
modifier_semantics.meaning: moving an item from the top position to the bottom position

task_intents: move low priority tasks to bottom

reasoning: This is an abstract UI action glyph (Material 'low_priority' / move item to the bottom of a list) rather than a concrete subject. At a glance in a task list it looks like interface chrome for reordering or text wrapping, and almost no real-world tasks have 'moving a list row down' as their central visual subject.
